_meta.source: NIRC § 24(A)(2), as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN Law)
notes: Graduated rates for individual taxpayers (compensation, business, and professional income).
Two schedules: TRAIN 2018–2022, and the lower 2023-onward rates. Looked up by asOf date.
Each bracket: tax = base + rate * (taxableIncome - over), for income above `over`.
First ₱250,000 of taxable income is exempt in both schedules.

8% option: self-employed/professionals with gross sales/receipts <= ₱3M (VAT threshold) may elect 8% on gross in excess of ₱250,000 (pure SEP), IN LIEU OF graduated income tax AND the 3% percentage tax. Mixed-income earners apply 8% to full gross (the ₱250k is used in the compensation computation).
